She longs to fly. The sky calls to her. It whispers of freedom, it promises of the warmth she has never known.

She responds with sad sonorous trumpets. She wants wings to manifest from her leviathan back, she wants to fly free as the birds she envy. But the cruel hand of reality, she knows, denies all. It has banished her to the cold clammy depths of the empty ocean, friendless and lonely.

And so, it is only in her dreams where she can fly. It is only in her dreams where she can slip through the nets of reality. In her dreams, anything is possible. She soars through the sunset sky on invisible wings, she gallops across emerald plains on legs that cannot be seen.

In her dreams, anything is possible. And her dreams are infinite.
